questions.stem:
Find the next term in the series:
B2, D4, F6, H8, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Pattern: Letters advance by +2 (B→D→F→H→J) and numbers advance by +2 (2→4→6→8→10). Next = J10. Trap: I9 skips by 1 letter; K11 goes to the next odd letter+number; J12 keeps the letter right but adds +4 to the number.

questions.stem:
Find the next term:
A1, C3, E5, G7, ?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Letters: A→C→E→G→I (skip 1 letter, +2 each time). Numbers: 1→3→5→7→9 (odd numbers / +2). Next = I9. Trap: H8 adds only +1 to letter and number; J9 skips one letter too many (I is correct, not J).

questions.stem:
Find the next term:
Z1, Y4, X9, W16, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Letters: Z→Y→X→W→V (reverse alphabet, −1 each). Numbers: 1→4→9→16→25 (perfect squares: 1²,2²,3²,4²,5²). Next = V25. Trap: U25 moves back 2 letters; V24 uses next even square; V20 uses addition instead of squares.

questions.stem:
Find the next term:
A2B, C4D, E6F, G8H, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Pattern: consecutive letter, even number, next consecutive letter. A-B(+2 skip=C starts), C-D(+2 skip=E), E-F, G-H, I-J. Numbers: 2,4,6,8,10. Each group: first letter, even number, second letter (consecutive to first). Next = I10J. Trap: I9J uses an odd number; J10K shifts the letter pair by one extra.
C is correct. Numbers increase by +5 (5,10,15,20,25). Letters advance by +1 (A,B,C,D,E). Next = 25E. Trap: 24E uses wrong number; 25D repeats the previous letter; 26F advances both incorrectly.

questions.stem:
Find the next term:
AB2, CD4, EF6, GH8, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Pattern: consecutive letter pairs + even number. AB(1-2), CD(3-4), EF(5-6), GH(7-8), IJ(9-10). Numbers: 2,4,6,8,10 (+2 each). Next pair = IJ, number = 10. Answer: IJ10. Trap: HI9 moves back one letter and uses odd number; JK10 skips letter pair I.

questions.stem:
Find the next term:
A3, D6, G9, J12, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Letters: A→D→G→J→M (every letter is +3: A=1, D=4, G=7, J=10, M=13). Numbers: 3→6→9→12→15 (+3 each, multiples of 3). Next = M15. Trap: L14 uses +2 for letter; M14 gets the letter right but uses +2 for number; N16 goes one step too far.

C is correct. First number: 2,4,6,8 (+2). Letter: A,C,E,G (skip 1 letter, +2). Last number: 5,10,15,20 (+5). Next = 8G20. Trap: 8F20 uses +1 for letter (F instead of G); 7F18 gets all three patterns wrong; 9G21 uses +3 for first number and +6 for last.

questions.stem:
Find the next term:
A1Z, C3X, E5V, G7T, ?
questions.explanation: C is correct. First letter: A,C,E,G,I (forward +2). Number: 1,3,5,7,9 (odd numbers +2). Last letter: Z,X,V,T,R (backward −2). Next = I9R. Verify: Z=26,X=24,V=22,T=20,R=18 (each −2). Trap: I9S uses S=19 (only −1 from T=20); J9R skips one position for the first letter.

questions.stem:
Find the next term:
ZA5, XC10, VE15, TG20, ?
questions.explanation: C is correct. First letter: Z→X→V→T→R (backward −2, positions 26,24,22,20,18). Second letter: A→C→E→G→I (forward +2, positions 1,3,5,7,9). Number: 5,10,15,20,25 (+5). Next = RI25. Verify: R=18(26−2×4=18 ✓); I=9(1+2×4=9 ✓); 5×5=25 ✓. Trap: RH25 uses H(8)=A+7 (one step behind); RJ25 uses J(10)=A+9 (one step ahead).
